_text: `line` is said on every pot's page and once in the funding box on /fund/; `card` is the short form. A thank-you, never a purchase: a dollar still buys nothing, the stickers change nothing on the ledger, and they are counted across a household's gifts to every pot in one calendar month, never per gift or per pot. They are mailed to the household's human. The founder reaches each qualifying household's human outside the town (an outside gift, which the office could not attach to a hand, through the payment's own email), and every address stays outside every town record.
